references.label: Swinging target
references.description: Upper-playfield target whose state advances during the main bonus route.
references.context: Keep the ball in the upper playfield and advance the swinging target.

references.label: Lit target-value lane
references.description: Top skill-shot lane that collects and advances the displayed swinging-target award.

references.label: Double Bonus saucer
references.description: Either lower side saucer activates Double Bonus after one A-B-C letter pair is complete.

references.label: Side upkicker
references.description: Lower side kickout used for raised-flipper control or a safe transfer toward the spinner.

references.label: Left spinner
references.description: High-value spinner only while the swinging-target cycle is in either 5,000-point position.
